description: composer test:modules collects 124 module-local test files - all 73 of the substantial ones are TaskRunner's - and fails in bulk. Group the failures by root cause into clusters, each with a reproducible test command and an independent fix path, and file one child issue per cluster. This ticket produces the report and the issues; fixing a cluster is the child issue's job. Verify the failure count at HEAD rather than trusting the number recorded in CLAUDE.md.
title: Cluster the TaskRunner module-test failures into an ordered report
